reason: Mostly mechanical swaps of Dictionary/Immutable dictionaries for FrozenDictionary behind IReadOnlyDictionary-typed properties (semantically equivalent, just optimizes lookup), plus removal of an unused public GetTimestamps() method in LuceneIndexManager which could theoretically break external callers relying on that API.
